I love to wrangle data and figure out how data pipelines can be built to answer intriguing questions!

Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone investigates factors associated with engagement with emergency shelter programs
established by a local organization, Church at the Park.

I care about figuring out how to best leverage data to help organizations make informed decisions and innovations. 

**Currently looking for** Not looking for a new role at this time, but always looking for opportunities and events to 
connect with other data enthusiasts! 

[Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
